Templates

Templates are the screen layouts: which organisms go where and the space between them. Every screen and sheet in the prototype uses one of these ten.

10templates
67screens and sheets
17things to decide

Page rhythm

The vertical spacing every scrolling template shares. Each value is a token; the measured screens below show where a screen keeps it and where it does not.

space-page-edge32Top bar → first block
space-group-break32Intro → content; card → next section heading
space-page-group16Section heading → its content
space-page-between24Block → block inside a section
space-card-line8Card → card in a list
space-page-pause48Before a part that stands apart (rare)
space-page-margin24Side margin
size-footer-clear210Last block → end of scroll (clears the footer)
gap matches its tokengap differs from the rule (listed under Decide)inside a part, not a template gaporganism slot

Rules
  • Content starts space-page-edge (32) under the top bar.
  • Intro to content: space-group-break (32).
  • A new section: space-group-break (32) above its heading, space-page-group (16) under it.
  • Blocks inside one section: space-page-between (24), cards in a list space-card-line (8).
  • Scroll ends size-footer-clear (210) under the last block, so it clears the footer.
Decide
  • Section break. 32 above a section heading on most screens. Different: m4 24, 24 and 48 (before SMS updates), i11 28, i6 40, a4 48. Snap all to 32, or keep 48 as a pause before a separate part?
  • Heading to content. 16 almost everywhere. Different: m4 13 (When), i11 12 and 18, i6 24. Snap to 16?
  • w6 (Your meeting). 24 from the intro (32 elsewhere), then cards 24, 12 and 11 apart. Snap to 32 and one card gap?
  • Rows without a card. i5 rows sit 13, 12, 16 apart; the note under a field is 13 (w4h) or 16 (m4). One value each?

Rules
  • Chips run edge to edge; the first chip lines up with the 24 margin.
  • Group headings use h4 (12 cap height), same as section headings in Step.
Decide
  • Card to filter. m8: 23 from the points card to the chips, then 16 to the grid. w2: 32 from intro to chips, then 20 to the first heading. One rule?
  • Group heading spacing. w2: 20 above “Best for your wait”, 24 above “Other nearby places”, 10 under it (16 under the first). In Step this is 32 above, 16 under. Use the Step values here too?
  • a1 heading. “Playing” is a small grey label (12 under it), not the h4 heading. Make it an h4 like the other groups?

Rules

  • Art to title space-hero-title (16).

Decide
  • Hero to what follows. Three values: 48 (m5, i12, a3, c1, c7), 40 (x4, m9, c6), 32 (p1, p7, w5, w5b, c5). One value, or 48 before a reward and 32 before a card?
  • Hero top. 32 everywhere except p1 16 and p7 20 (long screens pulled up to fit). Keep, or 32 for all?
  • Section break. c6 has 24 above “Words played”; elsewhere 32. Snap to 32?

Rules
  • The message sits in the middle of the free space between the top bar and the footer. Today each screen sets this by hand (see Decide).
Decide
  • Centring. Each screen has its own top padding: i4 127, i8 171, i10 178, x7 120. Inside, i4 has 100 between the title and the banner, i10 41 above the progress card. Replace with real vertical centring, so all four sit the same way? Positions would move by a few px.
